title: Gravitational Completion of the Corrected SFV/dSB O(4) Bounce: A Conditional Two-Field Coleman–De Luccia Theory
description: A reproducible gravitational completion of the corrected two-field SFV/dSB O(4) Euclidean tunneling saddle. The release derives the leading scalar–tensor O(4) Einstein–scalar boundary-value problem, independently reproduces regular gravitating CDL branches, maps action ordering and the CDL/Hawking–Moss merger, audits the constrained scalar–metric fluctuation spectrum, and provides Lorentzian open-FRW and thick-dS3 continuations. The result is explicitly conditional on four unresolved leading gravitational primitives {kappa, C, xi_P, xi_q} and one discrete source-law choice; it does not claim a unique absolute gravitational or dark-energy normalization. Permanent DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22070942.
